s1.title: Foundations
s1.description: Greetings, people, food, numbers, time, places, the home and health.

s2.title: Everyday life
s2.description: Describe things, get dressed, talk about your day, the weather, animals, work, school and travel.

s3.title: Conversations
s3.description: Say no, ask questions, talk about the past and the future, feelings, hobbies, phone calls and cooking.

u1.title: Greetings
u1.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and count to ten.

u2.title: People and things
u2.description: Family, everyday things and your first verbs.

u3.title: Food and the market
u3.description: Name staple foods, say you’re hungry and shop at the market.

u4.title: Numbers and money
u4.description: Count to thousands and pay in shillings.

u5.title: Time and days
u5.description: Talk about today, the days of the week and the time.

u6.title: Places and directions
u6.description: Name places in town, say where you’re going and give directions.

u7.title: The home
u7.description: Rooms and furniture, welcoming guests and asking for things.

u8.title: Health and the body
u8.description: Name parts of the body, say what hurts and see a doctor.

u9.title: Colours and describing
u9.description: Name colours and describe things and people.

u10.title: Clothes
u10.description: Name your clothes, get dressed and buy something new.

u11.title: My day
u11.description: Talk about your routine from morning to night.

u12.title: Weather and seasons
u12.description: Talk about sun and rain, the seasons and feeling hot or cold.

u13.title: Animals
u13.description: Farm animals, wild animals, pets and Uganda’s crested crane.

u14.title: Work and jobs
u14.description: Say what you do, ask about jobs and talk about pay.

u15.title: School
u15.description: The classroom, school subjects, questions and homework.

u16.title: Travel and transport
u16.description: Catch a taxi or bus and plan a journey across Uganda.

u17.title: Saying no
u17.description: Say what you don’t want, don’t have and don’t know.

u18.title: Asking questions
u18.description: Ask who, what, where, when and why, and ask about words.

u19.title: What I did
u19.description: Say what you’ve done today, what you did yesterday and long ago.

u20.title: Plans
u20.description: Talk about tomorrow, the weekend and your dreams.

u21.title: Feelings
u21.description: Say how you feel and show care for others.

u22.title: Hobbies and sport
u22.description: Talk about free time, football, music and games.

u23.title: On the phone
u23.description: Make calls, send messages and arrange to meet.

u24.title: Cooking
u24.description: Follow a recipe, cook matooke in banana leaves and share a meal.
